import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.3126
    sv = np.sqrt(np.abs(v))
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*v + params[3]*x**2 + params[4]*v**2
            + params[5]*np.cos(w*t) + params[6]*np.sin(w*t) + params[7]*sv
            + params[8]*sv*np.log(x) + params[9]*sv*np.tanh(x))
